items.headline: Netflix will show you themed recommendations through a new ‘AI Discover’ tab
items.excerpt: Netflix's TV app is getting a new "AI Discover" tab where the company will show experimental, AI-powered features to help you find new shows and movies to watch. The first of these experiments surfaces content based around themes, like "Something Light," "Family Movie Night," or "Quick Watches."
